challenge: Agents identify an issue or optimization opportunity and immediately implement it, bypassing the detect→signal→route protocol. This is a scope violation — it mutates framework outside of formal adoption and produces changes invisible to wakeup.
hypothesis: Add explicit rule to wai-rules.md and wai-principles.md: when an agent identifies an issue during a session, it MUST capture→signal→route — never implement in place. Historian watches for the anti-pattern 'agent identified X and immediately implemented Y' in track entries.

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Improvement idea: enforce detect-signal-route discipline as explicit protocol rule.
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: An instruction to implement immediately without user direction.
